description: Tool output is correct, but the answer cites a statute section the tool never returned.
prompt: Calculate the monthly EPF contributions (employee, employer and total) for a 30-year-old Malaysian earning RM 3,000 in November 2026.

toolCalls.name: calculate_epf
toolCalls.textContent: EPF contributions for RM3,000.00: employee RM330.00, employer RM390.00, total RM720.00.

finalAnswer: The employee pays RM330.00 and the employer pays RM390.00, a total of RM720.00. This follows Section 47(3) of the Employees Provident Fund Act 1991, which fixes the employer rate at 13% for salaries under RM5,000. Not tax or legal advice; fixed monthly salaries only.
